multi_entity_note: Single patient: maxillary sinus cholesteatoma transformed into squamous cell carcinoma.

medical.diagnosis.rationale: Final histopathology showed well-differentiated SCC, after earlier diagnoses of sinusitis and cholesteatoma.

medical.treatment_drug.rationale: Adjuvant chemoradiotherapy used cisplatin (first named) and 5-fluorouracil.
